_meta.notes: Comprehensive index of all thematic clusters (Level 4) and sub-clusters (Level 5) for Australia.

910.name: First Australians
910.description: Earliest human migration to Australia, Sahul landmass, oldest continuing cultures on Earth.

sub_clusters.name: Migration to Sahul
sub_clusters.description: Maritime crossing from Southeast Asia to the Sahul landmass via island-hopping.

sub_clusters.name: Lake Mungo Peoples
sub_clusters.description: Earliest known cremation and ochre burials; Lake Mungo archaeological sites.

sub_clusters.name: Australian Megafauna Coexistence and Extinction
sub_clusters.description: Interaction with giant marsupials, diprotodons, and other megafauna; debated causes of extinction.

sub_clusters.name: Ice Age Australia
sub_clusters.description: Last Glacial Maximum adaptations, Tasmania land-bridged, arid interior refugia.

910.name: Aboriginal Cultural Florescence
910.description: Post-glacial cultural diversification, Dreamtime traditions, rock art, fire-stick farming.

sub_clusters.name: Dreamtime and Oral Traditions
sub_clusters.description: Creation narratives, songlines, totemic geography, law systems.

sub_clusters.name: Rock Art Traditions
sub_clusters.description: Kimberley Bradshaw figures, Kakadu X-ray art, Sydney engravings.

sub_clusters.name: Fire-Stick Farming
sub_clusters.description: Controlled burning to manage landscapes, grasslands, and game.

sub_clusters.name: Torres Strait Islander Cultures
sub_clusters.description: Distinct maritime cultures, reef gardening, trade networks with Papua.

920.name: Macassan Contact Period
920.description: Indonesian (Macassan) trepang fishers visiting northern Australia; earliest sustained external contact.

sub_clusters.name: Trepang Trade Networks
sub_clusters.description: Sea cucumber harvesting, Arnhem Land contact sites, cultural exchange.

sub_clusters.name: Pre-European Contact Aboriginal Society
sub_clusters.description: Estimated 300,000–750,000 population, 250+ language groups, complex kinship systems.

930.name: Dutch Exploration of Australia
930.description: VOC explorers chart western and northern coastlines of 'New Holland'.

sub_clusters.name: Willem Janszoon Voyage
sub_clusters.description: First recorded European contact with Australia at Cape York.

sub_clusters.name: Hartog and VOC Landings
sub_clusters.description: Dirk Hartog inscription plate, Batavia shipwreck, western coast charting.

sub_clusters.name: Abel Tasman Voyages
sub_clusters.description: Discovery of Van Diemen's Land (Tasmania) and charting of northern coast.

930.name: British Exploration and Dampier
930.description: William Dampier and James Cook chart eastern Australia, setting stage for colonisation.

sub_clusters.name: William Dampier Voyages
sub_clusters.description: First Englishman to explore Australia; natural history observations.

sub_clusters.name: James Cook's First Voyage
sub_clusters.description: HMB Endeavour, Botany Bay, Great Barrier Reef, claiming eastern coast for Britain.

940.name: Convict Era and Early Settlement
940.description: British penal colony establishment; transported convicts shape early colonial society.

sub_clusters.name: First Fleet
sub_clusters.description: 11 ships, 1,500 people arrive at Sydney Cove; founding of New South Wales.

sub_clusters.name: Frontier Wars
sub_clusters.description: Armed conflicts between colonists and Aboriginal peoples; dispossession, massacres, resistance.

sub_clusters.name: Secondary Penal Settlements
sub_clusters.description: Norfolk Island, Van Diemen's Land, Moreton Bay; brutal conditions.

sub_clusters.name: Free Settlement Growth
sub_clusters.description: Wool industry expansion, free settlers, squatters, pastoral frontier.

940.name: Gold Rush Era
940.description: Gold discoveries transform economy, population, and politics.

sub_clusters.name: Victorian Gold Rush
sub_clusters.description: Ballarat and Bendigo goldfields; mass immigration, boomtowns.

sub_clusters.name: Eureka Stockade
sub_clusters.description: Miners' armed rebellion at Ballarat; catalyst for democratic reform.

sub_clusters.name: Chinese Goldfield Migration
sub_clusters.description: Significant Chinese immigration; anti-Chinese sentiment and restrictions.

940.name: Colonial Self-Government
940.description: Australian colonies gain responsible government; path toward federation.

sub_clusters.name: Responsible Government
sub_clusters.description: Colonies gain elected parliaments, male suffrage, secret ballot.

sub_clusters.name: Bushranging Era
sub_clusters.description: Ned Kelly, outlaws, rural resistance; mythology of the bush.

sub_clusters.name: Federation Movement
sub_clusters.description: Conventions, referendums, drafting of Constitution; Commonwealth proclaimed.

950.name: White Australia Policy Era
950.description: Immigration Restriction Act and racially selective immigration; gradual dismantling.

sub_clusters.name: Immigration Restriction Act
sub_clusters.description: Dictation test, exclusion of non-European immigrants.

sub_clusters.name: Stolen Generations
sub_clusters.description: Forced removal of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander children; assimilation policies.

sub_clusters.name: End of White Australia Policy
sub_clusters.description: Gradual policy relaxation, Whitlam government formally abolishes racial criteria.

950.name: Australia in the World Wars
950.description: ANZAC legend, Gallipoli, Western Front, Pacific theatre.

sub_clusters.name: Gallipoli Campaign
sub_clusters.description: ANZAC landings, Lone Pine, withdrawal; foundation of ANZAC legend.

sub_clusters.name: Australians on the Western Front
sub_clusters.description: Fromelles, Pozières, Passchendaele, Hundred Days; massive casualties.

sub_clusters.name: Conscription Referendums
sub_clusters.description: Two referendums; both defeated; deep social divisions.

sub_clusters.name: WWII Pacific Theatre
sub_clusters.description: Fall of Singapore, bombing of Darwin, Kokoda Track, Coral Sea.

sub_clusters.name: Curtin Wartime Government
sub_clusters.description: Pivot to US alliance, war mobilisation, home front transformation.

950.name: Post-War Immigration and Growth
950.description: Populate or perish; mass European immigration transforms Australian society.

sub_clusters.name: Displaced Persons Scheme
sub_clusters.description: Post-war European refugees; Snowy Mountains Scheme labour.

sub_clusters.name: Snowy Mountains Scheme
sub_clusters.description: Major hydroelectric engineering project; nation-building symbol.

sub_clusters.name: Suburban Expansion
sub_clusters.description: Quarter-acre block dream, car culture, baby boom.

960.name: Aboriginal Rights Movement
960.description: Land rights, reconciliation, self-determination; from Wave Hill walk-off to Apology.

sub_clusters.name: 1967 Referendum
sub_clusters.description: Constitutional amendment to count Aboriginal people in census; 90.77% yes vote.

sub_clusters.name: Wave Hill Walk-Off
sub_clusters.description: Gurindji people's strike and land claim; Vincent Lingiari.

sub_clusters.name: Aboriginal Tent Embassy
sub_clusters.description: Protest camp on Parliament House lawns; sovereignty assertion.

sub_clusters.name: Mabo Decision
sub_clusters.description: High Court overturns terra nullius; native title recognised.

sub_clusters.name: National Apology to Stolen Generations
sub_clusters.description: Prime Minister Kevin Rudd's formal apology in Parliament.

sub_clusters.name: Whitlam Reforms
sub_clusters.description: Medibank, free university, no-fault divorce, recognition of China.

sub_clusters.name: The Dismissal
sub_clusters.description: Governor-General dismisses elected PM; greatest constitutional crisis.

960.name: Multicultural Australia
960.description: Transition from Anglo-centric society to official multiculturalism.

sub_clusters.name: Asian Immigration Wave
sub_clusters.description: Vietnamese refugees, Asian economic migrants; demographic transformation.

sub_clusters.name: Multicultural Policy Framework
sub_clusters.description: Galbally Report, SBS broadcasting, multicultural affairs agencies.

960.name: Economic Reform Era
960.description: Hawke-Keating reforms: float the dollar, deregulation, superannuation, Accord.

sub_clusters.name: Hawke-Keating Economic Reforms
sub_clusters.description: Financial deregulation, tariff cuts, enterprise bargaining, compulsory super.

sub_clusters.name: Recession We Had to Have
sub_clusters.description: Economic downturn, unemployment spike, structural adjustment.

960.name: Contemporary Australia
960.description: Howard era, climate politics, mining boom, Voice referendum.

sub_clusters.name: Howard Government
sub_clusters.description: GST, gun reform, Tampa crisis, Iraq war, WorkChoices.

sub_clusters.name: Mining Boom
sub_clusters.description: China-driven resources boom; two-speed economy; sovereign wealth debates.

sub_clusters.name: Climate Politics
sub_clusters.description: Kyoto ratification, CPRS defeat, carbon tax, Paris Agreement.

sub_clusters.name: Voice to Parliament Referendum
sub_clusters.description: Proposed Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander advisory body; defeated at referendum.
